notes.title: 「KOEGASURU」 Strategy Guide Website Launched!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "KOEGASURU"!

It's been about a month since the game's release, and we've created a strategy guide to assist you. If you've encountered challenging puzzles or are interested in exploring hidden details after completing the game, we invite you to check it out!

Game guide⇩
https://yukimuma.net/blogs/20250514

notes.title: 『KOEGASURU』 is now available!
notes.notes:
Create your own music video by controlling Hatsune Miku and solving riddles!
  KOEGASURU” has been released!

[b]Information①[/b]
If you get certain items in the game, you can download the BGM in the game, TEMPLIME “KOEGASURU” instrumental soundtrack!

[b]Information②[/b]
When you press certain hidden keys, the characters will take cute poses!
Please look for it!

Depending on your PC specs, it may take some time to create the music video. We are sorry, but we would like you to wait for the clear screen as it is.

The answers to the riddles will be distributed at a later date!

notes.title: Guidelines for Uploading and Streaming Videos of "KOEGASURU"
notes.notes:
Posting and live streaming images or videos that use gameplay footage from "KOEGASURU" by Mochi Daigaku Gakubu (hereafter referred to as "our circle") is allowed.
To ensure everyone can enjoy it with peace of mind, please read and follow the guidelines below.
When posting or streaming, we would appreciate it if you could include a link to the Steam page in the video description or similar.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3646860/KOEGASURU/

[b]Rules for Posting and Streaming[/b]
[u]Monetization △[/u]
Commercial use is not permitted. However, monetization through official programs provided by video sharing platforms such as YouTube or Twitch (e.g., YouTube Partner Program) is allowed.

[u]Inappropriate Content ❌[/u]
Posting content that is offensive to public order and morals, illegal, or includes inappropriate information is prohibited.

[u]Excessive Editing ❌[/u]
Please refrain from excessive editing or alterations that may misrepresent the actual content of the game.

[u]Standalone Use of Assets ❌[/u]
Using in-game assets such as music, BGM, or character images as standalone material unrelated to the game is not allowed.

[u]Disclosure of Unreleased Content ❌[/u]
Do not publish any internal data or unreleased content obtained through game modification or reverse engineering.

[u]Unauthorized Reposting ❌[/u]
Reposting videos or screenshots created by others without permission is strictly prohibited.

[b]■ Prohibited Uses[/b]
This game features the character "Hatsune Miku," whose rights are held by Crypton Future Media, Inc. Therefore, the following types of use are strictly prohibited. Please respect these rules so all fans can enjoy the content safely.
(Excerpted in part from the Piapro Character Usage Guidelines)
https://piapro.jp/license/character_guideline

・Uses that significantly damage the character’s image
・Uses that harm the reputation of the original creators
・Uses that are offensive to public order and morals
・Uses that infringe on or may infringe on the rights of others

[b]■ Disclaimer[/b]
Our circle will not be held responsible for any issues or damages that may arise from posting or streaming videos of the game.

[b]■ Music Copyright Notice[/b]
This game includes songs managed by JASRAC.
When posting videos on platforms like YouTube, you may receive a “copyright claim.”
This does not indicate a copyright violation, and you may proceed with your upload as is.

※ These guidelines are subject to change without notice. Please ensure you are reviewing the latest version before posting.
Date of Establishment: April 22, 2025
